_comment: Plan catalogue. Pricing is PUBLIC and must be filled in from the real Neo pricing page before any demo — see _TODO below. The model never sees this file and never picks a plan; src/lib/rules.ts maps profile -> plan deterministically. Keeping prices here (not in the prompt) is what makes 'what if it hallucinates a price' a non-question.
_source: Read live from neo.space/ai-website-builder on 27 Aug 2026. These are the NEO SITES (website) plans, discounted first-year yearly billing. listPriceInr is the undiscounted figure shown struck through. Neo also sells mailbox plans separately — those are NOT captured here yet.
